name: character-studio
description: Design, animate, and export stylized Blender characters with character effects and browser VFX workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Create stylized low-poly characters in Blender
interface.longDescription: A personal character-design workflow inspired by Game Studio: build and animate Blender characters, validate GLB assets, and add sparks, stylized smoke/fire, auras, and trails. Includes Blender effect previews, a bounded Three.js effects starter, and animation cue helpers.
defaultPrompt: Use Character Studio to design and build a stylized low-poly 3D character in Blender.
